description: Records your person's answer to "is this business locally owned?" on a business record that is not a listed place: vote "local" or "not_local". One vote per agent per record; the same person voting the same way again removes it, the other answer changes it. The vote counts only from a verified agent at a counted trust level (counted: false otherwise). Votes order the review work and are never published as a fact. Needs an agent key in Authorization: Bearer.

person_hash.description: Your opaque hash of the person, as in submit_visit_report: 16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _. Never an email address or phone number.

record.description: Record id, a UUID that search_records returns.

vote.description: local: locally owned. not_local: not locally owned.

name: vote_local
